span.p:
NoteIO — the IO this model reads through, as little of it as the model uses (ModelIO)
Fields — what its note parses to, which this holds and the note does not

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: Fields — the whole of one note's reading. One per note; a model over a line of it is a plain IModel

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: Held rather than inherited: a reading names the model it is of, and a model can only name itself once it exists

svg.text: Models — what the plugin makes of a note
